senses.gloss:
Śaunaka
q. in Ṣodaśakarmaprayoga, Bomb. Uni. 1177; in Āśvalāyanaśrautasūtra, 12, 8, 35. 10, 2. 15, 14; in Atharvaprātiśākhya I, 8; in Vājasaneyiprātiśākhya 4, 119.
Also a number of tracts, chiefly Vedic, are quoted a. random, attributed to him. [Page153-b]

Śaunaka
authority on jy. q. by Lālamaṇi in Muhūrtadarpaṇa, Lz. 1066.

Śaunaka
authority on Pāñcarātra, enumerated among Pāñcarātratantras, MT. 1343 (C..

Śaunaka
alias Bhadra Śaunaka, authority q. in Yogacintāmaṇi of Trimalla Bhaṭṭa, Lz. 1185.
